name: hcapp_getRuns
description: Returns a user's run attendance history for a specific kennel — every event where their HasherEventMap AttendenceState >= 20, IsCountedRun = 1, IsVisible = 1 and the run has started (EventStartDatetimeGmt < SYSUTCDATETIME(), the reliable instant), ORDER BY CONVERT(DATETIME2, EventStartDatetime) DESC. Facebook-override columns (UseFbRunDetails, UseFbLocation) select between locally stored and imported name/location. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 22, @param NULL); the rows are the caller's own. Read SP — no success envelope; runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret. Default 'none'.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel whose run history to return. Null or zero-UUID treated as a validation error (errorCode 1222, errorType 12).

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when HC6.ValidateAppAuth fails (device not found, token invalid, etc.). errorType set by ValidateAppAuth (typically 11 for auth failures). Mutually exclusive with RunHistory rowset.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: KennelIdValidationError
rowsets.description: Returned when @kennelId is NULL or zero-UUID. errorCode=1222, errorType=12. Mutually exclusive with RunHistory rowset.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Always 12.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Always 1222.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Always 'Missing kennel'.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: Always 'A kennel must be specified.'.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: RunHistory
rowsets.description: User's attended run history for the specified kennel. Empty result set (zero rows) when the user has no qualifying runs. Returned only on successful auth and valid kennelId.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: Event.id — primary key of the event.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(DATETIME2, Event.EventStartDatetime) — the wall-clock start with the offset stripped (the Fb variant is NOT consulted). Table column is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) and carries a spurious +00:00 on ~67% of rows (see /hc-event-datetimes).

columns.name: eventEndDatetime
columns.description: Event.EventEndDatetime — passed through without conversion, preserving timezone offset.

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: FbEventName when Event.UseFbRunDetails = 1, else EventName (NVARCHAR(250); EventName is NOT NULL, FbEventName may be NULL).

columns.name: eventNumber
columns.description: Event.EventNumber — kennel-scoped run number. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: locationOneLineDesc
columns.description: Effective location with FB/non-FB fallback: COALESCE(preferred source, LocationOneLineDesc, FbLocationOneLineDesc, '<unknown location>'). Never NULL due to COALESCE default. Table column is NVARCHAR(250).

columns.name: userEventCounterIncrement
columns.description: Event.userEventCounterIncrement — how much this event increments the user's run counter. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: eventFacebookId
columns.description: Event.EventFacebookId — Facebook event identifier. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL.

columns.name: isVisible
columns.description: Event.IsVisible — visibility flag. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL. Always 1 in this result set (filter predicate enforces it).

columns.name: isCountedRun
columns.description: Event.IsCountedRun — whether this run counts toward totals. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL. Always 1 in this result set (filter predicate enforces it).

columns.name: absoluteEventNumber
columns.description: Event.AbsoluteEventNumber — cross-kennel run number. Table column is SMALLINT NULL.

columns.name: isHare
columns.description: HasherEventMap.IsHare — whether the user was a hare at this run. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalRunsThisKennel — running total of the user's attended runs at this kennel as of this event. Table column is INT NULL.

columns.name: totalRunsAllKennels
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalRuns — running total of the user's attended runs across all kennels as of this event. Table column is INT NULL.

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalHaringThisKennel coalesced to 0. Table column is INT NULL; COALESCE makes this non-nullable in the result.

columns.name: userStartEvent
columns.description: HasherEventMap.UserStartEvent — timestamp when the user checked in. Table column is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) NULL.

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: HasherEventMap.RsvpState coalesced to 0. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL; COALESCE is redundant but harmless.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: HasherEventMap.AttendenceState coalesced to 0. Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL; COALESCE is redundant but harmless. Always >= 20 in this result set (filter predicate enforces it).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing kennelId (lines 74-76) and from the CATCH block (lines 119-121, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId (line 3) has no SQL default (the other two do). A client that omits it gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs — instead of ValidateAppAuth's logged auth error.

codeSmells.issue: eventStartDatetime loses timezone offset via CONVERT to DATETIME2
codeSmells.detail: Line 85 strips the offset with CONVERT(DATETIME2, e.EventStartDatetime); the client receives the run's wall-clock start with no UTC offset, which is what the history list displays. The filter at line 110 correctly uses EventStartDateTimeGmt for 'in the past'; the ORDER BY at line 114 sorts by the stripped wall-clock value, which within one kennel is the natural order.

codeSmells.issue: COALESCE on NOT NULL columns is redundant
codeSmells.detail: COALESCE(hem.RsvpState, 0) and COALESCE(hem.AttendenceState, 0) operate on columns declared SMALLINT NOT NULL with DEFAULT 0. The COALESCE can never trigger and adds noise. Harmless but misleading.

codeSmells.issue: isVisible and isCountedRun are redundant in the result set
codeSmells.detail: Both columns are constrained to 1 by the WHERE clause (e.IsVisible = 1 AND e.IsCountedRun = 1), so they carry no information for the client. Including them wastes bandwidth but preserves symmetry with other event SPs.

breakingChanges: HC5 had two sequential @kennelId IS NULL checks with different errorTypes (2 then 3). HC6 collapses these into a single check (errorType 12). The second HC5 check was dead code and could never be reached, so no caller should observe this change.

HC5 returned errorType 2 for device-not-found (auth failure path). HC6 delegates auth to HC6.ValidateAppAuth which returns errorType 3 for device-not-found. Callers that branch on errorType for auth errors must be updated.
HC6 error rowset adds errorCode column (was absent in HC5 error rowset). Callers must handle the additional column.
HC6 error rowset drops debugMessage column (present in HC5 StandardErrorResult). Callers that read debugMessage will receive null or an error.
